annotations.title: Ask humans whether a statement is true in real life

description: Real people judge an everyday statement as true, not true, partly or unknown where they live, with reasons. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price on request – quoted individually. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.
